mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0% and rises by more than 0.1pp over three months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate and increases in nonfarm payrolls signal labor market strength that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines >0.1pp and PAYEMS increases >50k, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained retail sales growth above the 12-month moving average signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 12-month MA during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above its 6-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 6-month MA, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1,250,000 units per month, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1250.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines >0.1pp and UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
